text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen announced her entry into 
the Kikuka Sho. Mejiro Ryan lacked 
confidence, feeling there was no way her 
own ability could surpass McQueen's.

On Mejiro Ryan's behalf, the Trainer told 
her that her current,
refined muscles were 
her greatest weapon.

Though Mejiro McQueen had been skeptical 
at first, seeing Mejiro Ryan's refined 
muscles convinced her that they truly
were 
a formidable weapon.

The Kikuka Sho, where members of the 
Mejiro family will clash.
Its commencement 
was right around the corner.
